messages.text:
I found your returned wooden watch box. The order shows **R$49 paid**, so the refund proposal is **R$49**, rather than R$69. Refunds cover the amount actually paid. (refund-policy/v1/amount)

Please confirm using the **button on the proposal card**; a typed “yes” won’t confirm it. A staff member will then review the request. (refund-policy/v1/approval)
The customer confirmed request prop-257f5c7f795b47e7 and a staff member approved it, so it is ready to be paid.
